source.title: End of the Dark Horde
source.description: The deed is done. Dal'rend Blackhand, Warchief of the Dark Horde, lies dead at your feet. Take his head and present it to Master Shaw.
source.objective: Take the Head of Rend Blackhand to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
source.completion: Well done, champion.  The Warchief of the Dark Horde is dead, ending an era of terror in our lands. Let all of Stormwind know of your victory!
